for: Jony (UI) — bind dongle id Save like JWT/SSH; prefer auto from ADB/SSH
purpose: Persist mici dongle id via GUI Save or auto-discover from device; Connect/SSH lists use saved id only (no demo default)

GET /dongle.notes: dongle_id is null/empty until Save or auto-hydrate. Never treat a hardcoded demo id as the default. suggested_dongle_id comes only from reading /data/params/d/DongleId via ADB or SSH — never invent from ADB serial / hostname. If unset and discovery finds one, server auto-hydrates env+.cache (same path as POST /dongle) and sets auto_hydrated=true. Never overwrites a user-saved id. Manual Save remains the backup.

bind.load: GET /dongle → fill input when configured (dongle_id); else prefill from suggested_dongle_id; leave empty when both null
bind.save: POST /dongle { dongle_id, persist: true } on Save
bind.after_save: Refresh GET /routes (and Connect status); Connect uses saved id only
bind.discover: GET /discover also returns dongle + dongle_id + suggested_dongle_id / discovered_from (same shape under dongle key); matching ADB device may include dongle_id

expect.message: Dongle ID required · set via GUI Save

routes_connect_unset.never: silent fixture dongle 3e2de7ed673817c2 as happy path

bind.auto: Server may auto-hydrate when unset (auto_hydrated=true). UI may also prefill + POST /dongle from suggested_*. Label via discovered_from: 'Auto from ADB' / 'Auto from SSH'. Manual Save remains backup and is never overwritten by discovery.

storage.mirror: Same pattern as COMMA_JWT → .cache/connect_jwt and SSH → .cache/ssh_config.json

ready.message: Dongle ID required — POST /dongle (GUI Save) then refresh
ready.note: Demo job route remains optional; not required for production readiness. Flash stays gated. Big teacher / no demo locks unchanged.

discovery.prefer: ADB mici/comma devices first (skip emulators), then SSH when configured
discovery.auto_hydrate: If DISTILLERY_DONGLE_ID and .cache/dongle_id both unset and discovery finds a real id → write env + .cache (same as POST /dongle). Never overwrite user-saved id.
reject: fake id when ADB/SSH up but params empty
